sources.title: Visa Exemption for Maldivians travelling to Cambodia
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Maldivian Foreign Ministry notice directly states the effective date, passport classes and maximum stay for Cambodia's bilateral visa exemption.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Maldivians holding valid Diplomatic, Official and Ordinary passports to enter and stay in Cambodia a maximum period of thirty (30) days

policies.title: Maldivian ordinary passports: Cambodia visa-free short visits
policies.summary: The current Maldivian MFA guidance says the bilateral Cambodian visa exemption took effect on 4 May 2023 and covers ordinary passports for up to 30 days.
conditions: Applies to a valid Maldivian ordinary passport for entry, transit, stay and departure of no more than 30 days from entry.
A longer stay, work, study or business requires an appropriate visa before travel.
Final immigration admission and ordinary entry-document requirements remain applicable.

unresolved.reason: Tanzania Immigration's current guidance makes visa-on-arrival eligibility a named-nationality list and distinguishes it from online and referral routes. It provides no direct current ordinary Nicaraguan-passport result; neither the generic portal nor the list's omission is used to infer visa-on-arrival or advance issuance.
